lessons_content_by_type.name: lessons_content_by_type
lessons_content_by_type.value: ("lessons"."type" = 'article' and "lessons"."body" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'video' and "lessons"."video_url" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'pdf' and "lessons"."file_id" is not null) or ("lessons"."type" = 'link' and "lessons"."external_url" like 'https://%')

surveys_launched_has_dates.name: surveys_launched_has_dates
surveys_launched_has_dates.value: "surveys"."status" = 'draft' or ("surveys"."launched_at" is not null and "surveys"."closes_at" is not null)

home_banners_image_layout.name: home_banners_image_layout
home_banners_image_layout.value: "home_banners"."layout" <> 'image' or ("home_banners"."image_file_id" is not null and "home_banners"."cta_label" is null)

home_banners_period.name: home_banners_period
home_banners_period.value: "home_banners"."ends_at" is null or "home_banners"."starts_at" is null or "home_banners"."ends_at" > "home_banners"."starts_at"

announcement_attachments_kind.name: announcement_attachments_kind
announcement_attachments_kind.value: ("announcement_attachments"."kind" = 'file' and "announcement_attachments"."file_id" is not null and "announcement_attachments"."video_url" is null) or ("announcement_attachments"."kind" = 'video' and "announcement_attachments"."video_url" is not null and "announcement_attachments"."file_id" is null)

chat_messages_content.name: chat_messages_content
chat_messages_content.value: ("chat_messages"."deleted_at" is not null and "chat_messages"."body" = '' and "chat_messages"."file_id" is null) or ("chat_messages"."deleted_at" is null and char_length("chat_messages"."body") <= 4000 and (char_length(btrim("chat_messages"."body")) > 0 or "chat_messages"."file_id" is not null))

conversations_kind_shape.name: conversations_kind_shape
conversations_kind_shape.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' and "conversations"."direct_key" is not null and "conversations"."title" is null) or ("conversations"."kind" = 'group' and "conversations"."direct_key" is null and char_length(btrim("conversations"."title")) between 1 and 60)
